body:
**Original comment by Michael Ezra (Bitbucket: [Michael Ezra](https://bitbucket.org/Michael Ezra), ).**

----------------------------------------

Thank you for the prompt response! I didn’t realize that capture sharpening is the same as RL-deconvolution. Unfortunately, I hadn't had much time to follow RT development closely enough through the last few years. Perhaps there is a reason it was duplicated in the raw tab in RT. What’s interesting that just enabling this tool at default settings normally leads to great results, while RL-deconvolution has additional sliders which, although add flexibility, don’t help its usability. Thank you for pointing out the similarity.

About the noise reduction, I recognize the version in Art as a few years old, before Jacques expanded it with modulation by chrominance and with a few other tricks.
